name: clip-range
description: Anatomical angles against the clinical limits in assets/rig/ranges.json. (1) The rest pose, no keys, so the pose shown is measured. Hip bend x Knee bend, left. The thigh d = lowerleg01.L - upperleg01.L rest heads leans acos(-d.z) from straight down, its forward share -d.y / hypot(d.x, d.y): hip flexion 4.7276. The knee is the shank v (foot.L - lowerleg01.L) against the thigh u: acos(u.v) about unit(u x v), along the flexion axis unit(u x back-across-u): knee flexion 9.8991 (the rig's rest knee is bent). The hip limit at that knee bend joins 100 (knee straight, DSHS 13-585A) and 132.1 (knee bent 90, CDC): 100 + 32.1 * 9.8991 / 90 = 103.5307, extension -17.75. Closeness is the larger of the hip's |4.7276 - 42.8903| / 60.6403 = 0.6293 and the knee's (CDC range -1.3..139.8) |9.8991 - 69.25| / 70.55 = 0.8413. (2) The chest (spine01) turned 100 deg about +X, which bends it forward (+X x up = forward), keyed at frame 0: the trunk bends 100 forward with no side bend; its limits (DSHS: flexion 90, extension 25) put it 10 deg past, closeness (100 - 32.5) / 57.5 = 1.1739.

notes: the animation has no keys: measuring the pose shown alone
